title: kbmon's text view drops a panel's own reason: an absent coord store reads 'no mon_coord.py'
goal: the text view prints the reason a panel gives for a state other than ok (an absent store names the store, an unreachable server names the refusal), and says 'no mon_<name>.py' only when the module is missing

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
env=dict(os.environ,COLUMNS='400')
def k(*a):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--once',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
    if p.returncode not in (0,1): print('kbmon exit',p.returncode,p.stderr[-300:]);sys.exit(1)
    return [l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith(a[1]+' ')]
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();st=os.path.join(d,'none.sqlite');kf=os.path.join(d,'k')
open(kf,'w').write('planted'+'x'*20);os.chmod(kf,0o600)
a=k('--panel','coord','--store',st);b=k('--panel','coord','--url','http://127.0.0.1:9','--key-file',kf);c=k('--panel','bench')
print(a,b,c)
bad=[n for n,ok in (('absent names store',any(os.path.basename(d) in l for l in a)),('unreachable names refusal',any('refused' in l.lower() for l in b)),('no mon_ only when missing',not any('no mon_' in l for l in a+b+c))) if not ok]
print('bad',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

says 'no mon_<name>.py' only when the module is missing
